name: cru_goo_blue3
desc: Add a small amount of thick glossy HOT PINK paint goo with yellow marble streaks and dark outline (pink, not blue), only on and right around the small cat: short sticky blobs that glue the cat's wrists, ankles and back onto the chest behind it, plus a little goo smeared on the cat's cape and belly dripping down. No goo bands, no straps, nothing across the blue monster's shoulders, arms or chest muscles; the monster's muscular body must stay fully visible. Do not change the cat itself (same face, eyes, hat, cape, pose, size, position) and do not change the blue monster at all.
